title: How to use characters
slide_intent: Show how placement and size change the job of a character. A cover may need an arresting silhouette while an interior spread can use a smaller scene to explain a situation.
strategic_value: Frontline AIDS can use characters across publications, posters and social posts while retaining a recognizable illustration style.
demonstration: A tilted toolkit cover leads into a green field containing two publication spreads, a pink poster and a small social application.
practical_value: Compare the cover and spreads when deciding how much area an illustration deserves. Reserve enough space for the character to remain legible.

content_islands.name: Placement principle
content_islands.spec: Place the short guidance to the left and lead into the examples with a small pink arrow.

content_islands.name: Applications board
content_islands.spec: Overlap the enlarged blue cover with the edge of the green field. Arrange editorial spreads, poster and social example to its right so the changes of scale are visible.
